integrity: Claims proved using cellular signed Lefschetz and planar face-pair rank results; finite tests corroborate, but are not an all-parameter proof. No independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Integral H2 equivariance and rational H1 equivariance only; integral H1 representation, cohomology products, integral quotient homology and contractibility of quotients are not established. Residual bibliographic risk of less-indexed equivalent character descriptions.
title: Dihedral and layer-swap homology of two-particle prism configurations
